name: Swathi Arepalli
summary: Generalist strategy leader with 11+ years at Accenture Strategy, EY-Parthenon and Deloitte and an INSEAD MBA. Advises C-suites in telecom, infrastructure, financial services and consumer businesses on corporate and growth strategy, product and portfolio rationalisation, partnerships, carve-outs and digital positioning. Has restructured multi-entity telecom businesses, built organic and inorganic growth plans that lifted enterprise value, designed loyalty and customer insight programmes and set the long-term strategic direction for digital channels. Turns ambiguous questions into clear recommendations, crafts the narratives C-suites decide on and leads cross-functional teams to deliver them.

experience.title: Team Leader, Strategy Consulting – Corporate Strategy, Portfolio & Partnerships
bullets: Rationalised the product portfolio of a leading regional telco across 10 entities into a coherent set of segments and identified partnership strategies that opened new revenue streams for the group.
Led the carve-out of a telecom operator with 13+ consolidated entities into separate B2C, B2B, ICT and wholesale segments, defining the target structure and the path to get there.

Built the growth strategy for an infrastructure client by selecting between organic and inorganic options and reshaping the corporate strategy, lifting enterprise value by close to 30% and setting revenue growth of 25% to 30%.

Set the long-term strategic direction and market positioning for a B2B client's digital portal by reviewing the platform, redefining how customers should interact with it and proposing the enhancements needed to compete.
Designed a customer loyalty programme that raised retention, deepened customer understanding and improved frontline team performance.
Created a CX Sensor that structures customer reviews, filters out noise and surfaces the feedback that matters so the business can act on it.

experience.title: Senior Consultant, Strategy – Product Strategy, Market Entry & Growth
bullets: Sized the opportunity and built the business plan for a $50M consumer market entry across Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines that won board approval.
Developed a 5-year portfolio strategy for a $3B consumer products company that rationalised 25% of SKUs and prioritised 3 growth platforms behind a +180 bps margin plan.
Reset pricing, channel mix and trade incentives for a personal care brand which lifted modern trade share by 4 points and revenue by 12% in 12 months.

experience.title: Consultant, Strategy – M&A, Due Diligence & Digital Strategy
bullets: Benchmarked 15 fintech platforms to shape a digital growth strategy that secured executive committee approval for a $30M investment roadmap.
Built the integration plan for two merging banks across 40+ workstreams and quantified $60M in cost synergies.
Executed buy-side commercial due diligence on transactions valued between $200M and $2B.

experience.title: Business Analyst – Market Research & Competitive Intelligence
bullets: Delivered 30+ market sizing and competitor studies for Fortune 500 technology and banking clients that informed pricing, launch and investment decisions.
